# Chip Compound Interest

An offline compound interest calculator for iPhone and iPad by Chirag Mirani. US App Store price: $2.99 paid once for all features, with no ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases or account. Local prices are shown by Apple.

## Product facts

- Growth charts show Future Balance and Net Gain.
- Compare two plans without replacing the baseline until Apply.
- Goal solvers find contribution, time or required nominal return.
- PDF reports and CSV exports contain assumptions, schedules and a custom-scheme plan link requiring the app to be installed. Share App sends the App Store link.
- Inputs/plans stay locally; no account, tracking SDK or automatic cross-device sync.
- No withdrawals, taxes, fees, variable-market-return forecasts or currency conversion.
- This is an educational hypothetical calculator, not investment advice.
